about:
H & K Fabrication operates from Conway, Arkansas, supplying pipe welding tools and custom metal fabrication services to professional welders and industrial clients. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it presents itself as a specialist in pipe fabrication equipment and project-based fabrication work.

The business runs an e-commerce platform selling its own branded line of pipe welding tools, including Roll Out Wheels, Pipe Fitting Squares, Roller Heads, and Lathe Chucks, all featuring a zinc-plated finish. Alongside tool sales, the shop accepts custom fabrication projects ranging from custom bus racks to sanitizer stands, advertising that no project is too large or small. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Primary customers are professional pipe welders and pipefitters who purchase tools directly through the online store, as well as local businesses and contractors needing one-off fabricated assemblies. The company cites examples such as custom bus racks and sanitizer stands for area businesses, indicating a base in commercial and light industrial fabrication.

H & K Fabrication emphasizes that its tools are engineered to make pipe welding easier and more efficient, backed by a 30-day replacement guarantee for damaged or defective items. Standard shipping on tools runs three to five business days with an expedited option, and the company positions its curated product selection and project flexibility as its core differentiators.

name: H3 Plastics LLC
old_description: At H3 Plastics, we’re more than a supplier – we’re your partner. We strive to offer quality containers, real customer service, and flexibility for your needs. We make rigid packaging the easiest part of your business.
about:
H3 Plastics LLC is a family-owned rigid packaging manufacturer based in American Fork, Utah. The company launched in 2020 during the height of the COVID-19 bottle shortage, when an urgent need for packaging created a business culture centered on speed, quality, and responsive customer service. Although young, the business draws on decades of experience in manufacturing, construction, and engineering from its founders, instilling a culture of hard work, reliability, and long-term partnerships.

H3 produces both stock and custom plastic containers using Injection Stretch Blow Molding (ISBM), Reheat Blow Molding (RHB), and Injection Blow Molding processes. The facility runs modern blow molding platforms suited for small to mid-sized volume programs, working primarily with PET, HDPE, and post-consumer recycled (PCR) blends. In-house capabilities include design engineering, tooling management, finite element analysis, 3D prototyping, and integrated quality inspections covering gram weight, neck finishes, wall thickness, and leak testing. For hot-fill applications, the company offers MOQ flexibility down to 25,000 units.

The company serves health and nutrition, food and beverage, personal care, cosmetic, pet care, and household chemical markets. Customers range from medtech and specialty food brands to personal care companies, all supported by a dedicated design team and assigned representatives.

H3 differentiates itself through its family-owned values—hard work, reliability, quality control, and pride—and through certified quality systems (SQF and IMS). Sustainability is engineered into operations via lightweight designs, PCR material options, reusable packaging solutions, and energy-efficient auxiliary systems.

name: HB Molding
old_description: HB Molding was founded in 1998 and originally located in the south side of Louisville. Due to our ability to quickly react to customer demands and opportunities we have grown to a 37-injection molding press operation housed in 78,000 sq.ft. of production facilities on the east side of Louisville with quick access to major North and South interstate roadways. HB Molding has a proven track record of delivering value to our customers. We supply products and services to a variety of industries as both a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier. HB Molding is ISO 9001:2015 certified with in-house 3D scanning capability.
about:
HB Molding was founded in 1998 on the south side of Louisville, Kentucky, by Mark Hallam, who remains the owner. The privately held company relocated to a 78,000-square-foot facility in Jeffersontown on the east side of Louisville, with direct access to major north–south interstates.

The shop operates 35 to 37 injection molding presses ranging from 120 to 500 tons with shot capacities of 4 to 60 ounces, running five days a week, 24 hours a day, with weekend availability for demand spikes. Core processes include injection molding, ultrasonic welding, hot stamping, pad printing, assembly, and tool building, supported by in-house 3D scanning for quality inspection.

HB Molding serves as both a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier to original equipment manufacturers, notably GE Appliance, which recognized the company with a 2017 Supplier Quality Performance Award and a 2018 “Silent Warrior” award. The facility primarily supports customers within a 200-mile radius of Louisville across appliance and industrial manufacturing sectors.

The company emphasizes rapid response to customer needs, a capability that drove its growth from a single location to a multi-press operation. ISO 9001:2015 certification and in-house metrology reinforce its quality system, while proximity to interstate highways enables efficient logistics for regional clients.

HG Metals operates from Indianapolis, Indiana, as an active division of HGMC Supply, Inc. The company is led by President and Owner Ashley Collins, who brings over 15 years of corporate management experience. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the team has delivered steel fabrication services for over two decades.

The shop specializes in structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, producing items such as structural framing, support systems, custom stairs, rails, ladders, mezzanines, equipment platforms, canopies, and other specialty metal fabrications. Fabrication is performed in-house using modern CNC equipment, and welding is carried out by personnel certified to AWS D1.1 unlimited standards. The facility ships completed assemblies nationwide.

HG Metals serves commercial and construction clients across Indiana and the broader United States, including general contractors and developers working on large-scale commercial developments as well as custom one-of-a-kind structures. The company's project portfolio spans structural steel packages and miscellaneous metal components for a variety of building types.

The company emphasizes communication, coordination, and accountability from bid through final delivery, aiming to keep steel on the critical path of a project. This approach is framed as building relationships and solving problems rather than simply fabricating steel.

name: HIGH PINE CUSTOM APPAREL
old_description: Our manual screen printing process combines skilled craftsmanship with lasting quality. Ink is pressed through a fine mesh screen onto each garment, with a separate screen used for every color in the design. We use durable inks and meticulously maintained screens to produce sharp, detailed artwork. Whether it’s a small batch or a large run, every order receives the same care and attention to detail.
about:
High Pine Custom Apparel operates from a facility at 320 Ossipee Trail West in Standish, Maine. The company provides custom screen printing, embroidery, transfer printing, and graphic design services to businesses, brands, and musical acts.

The shop runs a manual screen printing process that uses a separate mesh screen for each color in a design, applying durable inks for sharp, detailed artwork. Embroidery work is digitized in-house and stitched with quality thread, with options for 3D puff and appliqué. Transfer printing uses heat and pressure to apply full-color designs, suited for high-color artwork, small runs, or budget-friendly projects. The team also offers in-house graphic design ranging from logo creation to full brand identity builds, and produces stickers and other branded goods. Orders range from small batches to large runs, with each receiving the same level of attention.

Customers include businesses seeking branded apparel, musical acts such as Muscadine Bloodline's Charlie Muncaster who wore High Pine gear on tour, and organizations needing promotional items or workwear. The company serves clients looking for custom hoodies, hats, and other garments, as well as those needing brand development support.

High Pine emphasizes skilled craftsmanship and consistent quality across its processes. Its manual screen printing and in-house digitizing allow control over detail and durability, while transfer printing adds flexibility for complex, multi-color designs. The combination of production and design services under one roof is intended to streamline the path from concept to finished product.

old_description: We stock brand new and authentic IC’s from the industry’s leading manufacturers such as Analog Devices, TI, Intel, Xilinx, Maxim, and more. In a rush? We offer expedited shipping to get them to you the next day!
about:
HMB Electronics operates from North Haven, Connecticut, as a women-owned small business. The company was established to meet growing demand for expedited shipments of electronic components, leveraging a vast network of suppliers both domestically and internationally to serve customers across the Northeast and beyond.

As a stocking distributor, HMB Electronics carries a broad line of name-brand electronic components including integrated circuits, resistors, transistors, capacitors, connectors, and computer peripherals. The firm maintains a fully equipped warehouse with temperature control, anti-static workbenches, and full-time monitoring to ensure proper handling of sensitive parts. Core services encompass same-day shipping on stocked items, obsolete and end-of-life component sourcing, cross-referencing for alternative parts, excess inventory purchasing, and third-party component testing and verification through a regional facility.

The company serves government agencies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), contract manufacturers (CMs), and both franchised and non-franchised distributors. Its customer base spans military, information technology, and general OEM sectors, with components sourced from manufacturers such as Analog Devices, Texas Instruments, Intel, Xilinx, Maxim, and numerous other brands.

HMB Electronics differentiates itself through a 110% quality guarantee, AS5553 compliance for counterfeit electronic parts avoidance, and a commitment to providing manufacturer traceability certificates wherever possible. The firm’s partnership with an independent testing facility and its excess inventory purchasing program further reinforce its focus on authenticity and supply-chain reliability.

name: Haake Manufacturing Co
old_description: We’re not just sheet metal fabricators. We’re professional problem solvers ready to help solve your complex metal part challenges.
about:
Haake Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1948 by Fred C. Haake Sr. and his wife Elfriede in a St. Louis garage as a small tool-and-die shop. The German-trained machinist started with a single punch press and a commitment to quality that quickly earned the trust of local manufacturers. In 1963, the second generation—Fred Jr. and Lorraine Haake—relocated the operation to De Soto, Missouri, adding a company-owned trucking fleet to guarantee on-time delivery. Today, the fourth-generation family business is led by Jay Rieker and operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility in De Soto.

The company provides precision custom sheet metal fabrication entirely under one roof. Core processes include CNC laser cutting (up to 10,000 watts), CNC punching, combined punch/laser processing, CNC press brake forming with six-axis back gauges, metal stamping using AIDA cells up to 160 tons and auxiliary presses from 5 to 150 tons, robotic MIG/MAG welding of steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, and a fully automated powder coating line with six-stage wash, infrared pre-processing, and zirconium pretreatment. Secondary services such as assembly, hardware insertion, and metal finishing coordination deliver turnkey components.

Haake serves manufacturers across the United States from its central U.S. location, with a historical customer base that includes aerospace firms such as McDonnell Douglas and a broad range of Midwest industrial companies. The shop handles short-run prototypes through long-run production volumes, emphasizing just-in-time delivery programs that support inventory management and cash flow.

The company differentiates itself through integrated, in-house capabilities that eliminate supplier handoffs, a central location enabling two-day shipping to either coast, ISO 9001:2015 certification with reported defect rates of 292 PPM for fabrication and 0 PPM for powder coating, and a 99% on-time delivery record. Low operating costs powered partly by solar energy and a domestic supply chain focus further support cost competitiveness and reshoring efforts.

name: Haas & Sons Electric - Electricians
old_description: provide a full range of electrical services. From additions and remodeling, to residential lighting design, to electrical repair, we are your full-service family company offering competitive pricing and a satisfaction guarantee.
about:
Haas & Sons Electric operates from Millersville, Maryland, as a family-owned and operated electrical service company. The business was founded by the Haas family, though the exact founding year is not publicly stated; the firm notes over 26 years of combined experience among its team of licensed electricians.

The company provides a full range of residential and commercial electrical services, including repairs, lighting design and installation, electrical panel upgrades (heavy ups), outlet and switch work, troubleshooting, energy efficiency maintenance, EV charger installation, generator installation, landscape and security lighting, ceiling fan installation, circuit breaker and outlet repair, aluminum wiring replacement, whole-house rewiring, and home automation systems. Services are delivered by uniformed, licensed electricians operating from fully stocked trucks equipped with surge protectors, AFCI breakers, dimmer switches, and diagnostic tools. The firm emphasizes OSHA-compliant practices and factory-trained expertise.

Haas & Sons primarily serves homeowners across Maryland, with a focus on Anne Arundel County, as well as commercial clients needing electrical services. Typical projects range from older homes requiring rewiring and fuse box conversions to modern upgrades such as EV charging stations, hot tub wiring, and residential dock electrical systems. The company also performs free home safety inspections with any standard scheduled call, checking GFCI outlets, smoke detectors, and main panels for code violations.

The company states its mission is to deliver prompt, efficient, and expert electrical services that exceed customer expectations, with immediate response for emergency calls. Differentiators cited include upfront pricing without hidden fees, on-time arrival, thorough cleanup with boot-covers, and a five-year warranty on lighting installations. The firm holds BBB accreditation with an A+ rating and has been recognized by BuildZoom as a top 1% Maryland licensed contractor.

name: Haf Equipment
old_description: HaF Equipment is a dry ingredient handling equipment manufacturer whose systems are designed to focus on partner success and excellence across various verticals and applications, from the food industry to pharmaceuticals and plastics.
about:
Haf Equipment is based in Maplewood, Minnesota. The company was founded in 1994 by Pete Hoefler with a focus on dry material handling and has grown into a privately held manufacturer of ingredient handling systems.

The company designs and manufactures material handling systems for dry and liquid ingredients. Its product range includes filter receivers, bulk bag unloaders, feeders, pneumatic and mechanical conveyors, blending equipment, dust collectors, air pollution control systems, batching systems, and liquid handling assemblies. Haf offers both off-the-shelf H-Series equipment and customized M-Series tool-free quick take-apart designs. The firm employs 3D modeling for every system and operates a quality control process that inspects every piece before shipment.

Haf serves industries such as food processing, dairy, pharmaceuticals, plastics, chemicals, nutraceuticals, pet food, bakery, snacks, ceramics, steel, batteries, rubber, and air pollution control. Customers range from small plants to large facilities worldwide.

The company emphasizes operator-centric design, innovative solutions for powder and bulk handling, and a team-based quality culture. Its "HAF Difference" values include team focus, humble confidence, elite performance, hustle, and driven yet fun. In 2024, Haf acquired the assets of Semi Bulk Systems to expand into liquid ingredient handling.
